title: Grade 10 Mathematics National Exam & Practice 2024 (6 Chapters Combined)
description: Comprehensive examination bank combining 6 chapters (100 questions). Official Ethiopian national curriculum.

questions.questionText: Which of the following relations is a function?
questions.explanation:
A relation is a function if every x-value is mapped to only one y-value (passes the vertical line test).

 R3 is a parabola opening upwards and passes this test.

 R1 is a parabola opening right, R2 is a circle, and R4 has two y-values (5 and -5) for x=3.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of the function f(x) = (x + 1) / (x² - 16)?
questions.explanation:
The domain excludes values that make the denominator zero.

 x² - 16 = 0 implies x² = 16, so x = 4 or x = -4. 

The domain is the set of all real numbers (R) excluding -4 and 4.

questions.questionText: Find the range of the function f(x) = 7 - |x + 2|.
questions.explanation:
Since |x + 2| is always greater than or equal to 0, -|x + 2| is always less than or equal to 0.

 Therefore, f(x) = 7 - |x + 2| is always less than or equal to 7.
 The range is (-∞, 7].

questions.questionText: What is the domain of the function g(x) = √(12 - 3x)?
questions.explanation:
For the square root to be defined, the expression under the root must be non-negative: 12 - 3x ≥ 0.

 This means 12 ≥ 3x, or x ≤ 4. 
The domain is (-∞, 4].

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x³ + 2 and g(x) = 2x - 1, find the value of (f + g)(1).
Which of the following functions is a one-to-one function?
questions.explanation:
A one-to-one function must pass the horizontal line test.
 The linear function f(x) = 2x + 9 is strictly increasing, making it one-to-one.
 The others fail the horizontal line test (e.g., |1| = |-1|).

questions.questionText: If the graph of f(x) is symmetric with respect to the origin, what can be concluded about f(x)?
options: f(x) is neither even nor odd.
questions.explanation: Symmetry with respect to the origin is the graphical definition of an odd function, where f(-x) = -f(x).

questions.questionText: The graph of y = (x - 5)² is the graph of y = x² shifted:
questions.explanation: A transformation of the form f(x - c) shifts the graph of f(x) by c units to the right. Here, c = 5, so the shift is 5 units to the right.

questions.questionText: What is the range of the function f(x) = 4 + x²?
questions.explanation:
Since x² ≥ 0, the minimum value of f(x) occurs when x² = 0, which is f(0) = 4.

 The range is [4, ∞).

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = 1 / √(x - 3)?
questions.explanation:
For the function to be defined, the term under the square root must be strictly positive: x - 3 > 0. 
Thus, x > 3. The domain is (3, ∞).

questions.questionText: Given f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 5. Find the expression for (f - g)(x).
Which function is an even function?
questions.explanation:
A function is even if f(-x) = f(x).
 For f(x) = x⁴ - 2x² + 1, 
f(-x) = (-x)⁴ - 2(-x)² + 1 =
 x⁴ - 2x² + 1 = f(x).

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = √(x² - 25)?
questions.explanation:
For the function to be real, the radicand must be non-negative: x² - 25 ≥ 0. 
This inequality holds when x ≤ -5 or x ≥ 5.
 The domain is (-∞, -5] ∪ [5, ∞).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x - 3 and g(x) = 5, find the domain of (f / g)(x).
questions.explanation:
The domain is R excluding values where g(x) = 0.
 Since g(x) = 5 is never zero, the domain is R.

questions.questionText: A function f: A → B is said to be **onto** (surjective) if:
options: For every x in A, there is a unique y in B.
Every element in B is the image of at least one element in A.
The domain of f is equal to B.
questions.explanation:
A function is onto (surjective) if its range is equal to its codomain (B).

 This means every element in B is covered by the function.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x² and g(x) = x + 1, find the value of (f ⋅ g)(-2).
What is the domain of f(x) = (x - 1) / (x³ - x)?
questions.explanation:
Factor the denominator: x³ - x = x(x² - 1) = x(x - 1)(x + 1).
 The function is undefined when x = 0, x = 1, or x = -1.
 The domain is R excluding these three values.

questions.questionText: If f(x) is an odd function, and f(-4) = -10, what is the value of f(4)?
questions.explanation:
For an odd function, f(-x) = -f(x).
 We have f(-4) = -10, so -f(4) = -10.
 Therefore, f(4) = 10.

questions.questionText: The range of the function f(x) = 2x - 5 for the domain [0, 3] is:
questions.explanation:
f(x) is linear, so the range is determined by the endpoints.
 f(0) = 2(0) - 5 = -5. 
f(3) = 2(3) - 5 = 1.
 The range is [-5, 1].

questions.questionText: Which set of ordered pairs represents a function that is not one-to-one?
questions.explanation: In the set {(1, 5), (2, 5), (3, 6)}, both x=1 and x=2 map to the same y-value, y=5, so it is not one-to-one.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = -f(x) is the graph of y = f(x) reflected across the:
questions.explanation: Multiplying the entire function by -1, i.e., y = -f(x), results in a reflection of the graph across the x-axis.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = (x + 5) / (x² + 4)?
questions.explanation:
The denominator x² + 4 is always greater than or equal to 4 (since x² ≥ 0). 

Since the denominator is never zero, the domain is the set of all real numbers (R).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = |x - 1|, find the range of f(x).
questions.explanation:
The absolute value of any real number is always greater than or equal to zero.

 Therefore, the range of f(x) = |x - 1| is [0, ∞).

questions.questionText: Given f(x) = x / (x + 3) and g(x) = 2x. Find the domain of (f / g)(x).
questions.explanation:
Domain(f) is R \ {-3}. 
g(x) = 0 when x = 0.
 The combined restriction is R \ {0, -3}.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5x - 8, which point must lie on the graph of f(x)?
questions.explanation:
Check the options: f(-1) = 5(-1) - 8 = -5 - 8 = -13.
 The point (-1, -13) lies on the graph.

questions.questionText: A function whose graph is symmetric with respect to the y-axis is called:
questions.explanation: Symmetry with respect to the y-axis is the graphical property of an even function, satisfying f(-x) = f(x).

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = x / |x|?
questions.explanation:
The function is defined for all x where the denominator is not zero.
 Since |x| = 0 only when x = 0, the domain is R \ {0}.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 9x + 2 and g(x) = 5x - 7, find the expression for (f - g)(x).
The range of the linear function f(x) = 6x - 1 on the set of all real numbers (R) is:
questions.explanation: The graph of a non-constant linear function extends infinitely in both the positive and negative y-directions. The range is R.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a key characteristic of an onto (surjective) function from R to R?
options: It passes the horizontal line test.
Its graph must pass through the origin.
questions.explanation: A function f: R → R is onto if its range covers the entire codomain R.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = -x² is the graph of y = x² subjected to a reflection across the:
questions.explanation: When the sign of the entire function is changed (y = -f(x)), the graph is reflected across the x-axis.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x + 1 and g(x) = 3x, find the value of (f ⋅ g)(1).
What is the domain of the function f(x) = √((x + 1) / (x - 4))?
questions.explanation:
The fraction must be non-negative: (x + 1) / (x - 4) ≥ 0, and the denominator cannot be zero (x ≠ 4). 

This occurs when x ≤ -1 or x > 4.
 The domain is (-∞, -1] ∪ (4, ∞).

questions.questionText: Which is the correct graph transformation of y = f(x) to y = f(x) + 2?
questions.explanation:
The transformation y = f(x) + c shifts the graph vertically by c units.
 Adding 2 shifts the graph 2 units up.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 10x and g(x) = x + 3, find the expression for (f / g)(x) and its domain.
questions.explanation:
(f / g)(x) = 10x / (x + 3).
 The domain is R excluding values where the denominator is zero, x = -3.

questions.questionText: Which of the following functions is neither even nor odd?
questions.explanation:
f(-x) = (-x)³ + (-x)² = -x³ + x².
 Since f(-x) ≠ f(x) and f(-x) ≠ -f(x), the function is neither.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = |x - 2| is the graph of y = |x| shifted:
questions.explanation:
A transformation of the form f(x - c) shifts the graph horizontally to the right by c units.
 Here, c = 2.

questions.questionText: Find the range of the function f(x) = √(x - 9).
questions.explanation:
The range of the basic square root function is always [0, ∞).
 The smallest y-value is 0.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 3x² - 2 and g(x) = x + 1, find the value of (f + g)(0).
Which function is onto (surjective) from R to R?
questions.explanation:
A function f: R → R is onto if its range is R.
 The cubic function f(x) = x³ - x extends from -∞ to +∞ vertically, so its range is R.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = 2f(x) represents which transformation of the graph of y = f(x)?
questions.explanation:
Multiplying a function by a constant greater than 1, y = c ⋅
 f(x) (where c > 1), results in a vertical stretch.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 6, find the domain of f(x).
questions.explanation:
A constant function is defined for all real numbers.
 The domain is R.

questions.questionText: What is the range of the function f(x) = 5x - 2?
questions.explanation: Since f(x) is a non-constant linear function, its range is the set of all real numbers (R).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 2x and g(x) = 3x + 1, find the expression for (f ⋅ g)(x).
Which set of ordered pairs represents a function?
questions.explanation: The set {(2, 1), (3, 2), (4, 3)} is a function because each input (x-value) is associated with exactly one output (y-value).

questions.questionText: What is the domain of the rational function f(x) = x / (x² - 4x)?
questions.explanation:
Factor the denominator: x² - 4x = x(x - 4).
 The function is undefined when x = 0 or x = 4. 
The domain is R excluding 0 and 4.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 4x - 1 and g(x) = 2x - 5, find the value of (f - g)(2).
A function that is one-to-one (injective) from its domain to its range must satisfy which condition?
options: It passes the vertical line test
It passes the horizontal line test
questions.explanation:
A function is one-to-one if distinct inputs map to distinct outputs. 
Graphically, this is verified by the horizontal line test.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = -|x| is the graph of y = |x| reflected across the:
questions.explanation: The negative sign outside the function, y = -f(x), causes a reflection across the x-axis.

questions.questionText: The function f(x) = 4 is an example of what type of function?
questions.explanation: A function of the form f(x) = c is called a constant function.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 7x + 3 and g(x) = 7x - 3, find the expression for (f - g)(x).
The graph of y = |x + 1| is the graph of y = |x| shifted:
questions.explanation:
The transformation f(x + c) shifts the graph c units to the left. 
Here, c = 1, so the shift is 1 unit left.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = 1 / (x - 2) + √(x + 3)?
questions.explanation:
Domain of 1 / (x - 2) is R \ {2}.
 Domain of √(x + 3) is x ≥ -3.
 The intersection is [-3, 2) ∪ (2, ∞).

questions.questionText: The range of the function f(x) = -2x² + 3 is:
questions.explanation:
Since x² ≥ 0, -2x² ≤ 0. 
Adding 3, f(x) ≤ 3.
 The range is (-∞, 3].

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5 and g(x) = x² - 1, find the value of (f ⋅ g)(4).
A function that is not onto from R to R is:
questions.explanation:
For f(x) = x² + 1, the range is [1, ∞), which is a proper subset of the codomain R.
 Hence, it is not onto.

questions.questionText: Which of the following functions is a linear function?
questions.explanation:
A linear function has the form f(x) = mx + b.
 f(x) = 3x - 7 is linear.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x - 2, and the domain is {0, 1, 2, 3}, what is the range?
Which transformation maps the graph of y = f(x) to y = f(x + 4)?
questions.explanation:
The transformation y = f(x + c) shifts the graph horizontally to the left by c units.
 Here, c = 4.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = ³√(x + 1)?
questions.explanation:
The cube root function is defined for all real numbers.
 The domain is R.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 2x and g(x) = x, find the domain of (f / g)(x).
questions.explanation:
The domain of (f / g)(x) is R excluding values where g(x) = 0.
 Since g(x) = x, the domain is R \ {0}.

questions.questionText: Which is true about the function f(x) = 5x³?
options: It is neither even nor odd.
questions.explanation:
f(-x) = 5(-x)³ = -5x³ = -f(x).
 It is an odd function.

questions.questionText: The range of the function f(x) = -√x is:
questions.explanation:
The range of √x is [0, ∞).
 Multiplying by -1 reflects the range to (-∞, 0].

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = (x² + 5x + 6) / (x + 3)?
questions.explanation:
The domain excludes values that make the denominator zero. x + 3 = 0 implies x = -3. 
The domain is R \ {-3}.

questions.questionText: Which relation is NOT a function?
questions.explanation: The equation x = 9 represents a vertical line, which fails the vertical line test, so it is not a function.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = x² + 1 and g(x) = 3, find the expression for (f ⋅ g)(x).
What is the range of the function f(x) = 2 - x²?
questions.explanation:
Since -x² ≤ 0, f(x) = 2 - x² ≤ 2.
 The maximum value is 2.
 The range is (-∞, 2].

questions.questionText: A function that is one-to-one from R to R is also necessarily:
options: monotonic function (strictly increasing or strictly decreasing)
questions.explanation: A continuous one-to-one function on R must be strictly monotonic (always increasing or always decreasing).

questions.questionText: The graph of y = |x| is reflected across the y-axis. The resulting equation is:
questions.explanation: Since y = |x| is already an even function (symmetric about the y-axis), reflecting it across the y-axis does not change the equation.

questions.questionText: If f(x) is an even function and f(2) = 5, what is f(-2)?
questions.explanation:
For an even function, f(-x) = f(x).
 Since f(2) = 5, then f(-2) = 5.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = √(3 - x)?
questions.explanation:
The radicand must be non-negative: 3 - x ≥ 0.
 Thus, x ≤ 3. 
The domain is (-∞, 3].

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 6x and g(x) = x², find the expression for (f + g)(x).
questions.explanation:
(f + g)(x) =
 f(x) + g(x) =
 6x + x² = x² + 6x.

questions.questionText: The equation of the horizontal asymptote of the rational function f(x) = (x + 5) / (2x² + 1) is:
questions.explanation: Since the degree of the numerator (1) is less than the degree of the denominator (2), the horizontal asymptote is y = 0.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 8x + 1, find the value of f(0).
A function that is not onto from R to R but is defined for all x in R is:
questions.explanation: The function f(x) = x² + 2 has a range of [2, ∞), which is not all of R.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = f(x) - 1 is the graph of y = f(x) shifted:
questions.explanation: Subtracting a constant 'c' outside the function, f(x) - c, shifts the graph vertically down.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 3x - 1 and g(x) = x + 1, find the domain of (f / g)(x).
questions.explanation:
The domain is R excluding values where g(x) = 0.
 x + 1 = 0 when x = -1. 
The domain is R \ {-1}.

questions.questionText: The range of the function f(x) = 5 - √x is:
questions.explanation:
Since √x ≥ 0, -√x ≤ 0.
 Adding 5, f(x) ≤ 5.
 The range is (-∞, 5].

questions.questionText: If f(x) = |x| and g(x) = 2, find the value of (f ⋅ g)(-5).
The graph of y = -f(x + 2) is the graph of y = f(x) subjected to which transformations?
questions.explanation:
The negative outside f(x) is a reflection over the x-axis.
 The (x + 2) inside is a shift 2 units to the left.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 3x² + 1, what is the value of f(-x)?
questions.explanation:
f(-x) = 3(-x)² + 1 = 3x² + 1.
 Since f(-x) = f(x), the function is even.

questions.questionText: A function whose range is equal to its codomain is called a(n) ________ function.
questions.explanation: The definition of a surjective (onto) function is one where the range is equal to the codomain.

questions.questionText: What is the range of the function f(x) = |x| + 4?
questions.explanation:
Since |x| ≥ 0, f(x) = |x| + 4 ≥ 4.
 The range is [4, ∞).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5x + 1 and g(x) = 5x - 1, find the expression for (f + g)(x).
If f(x) = 2x - 3 and g(x) = 2x, find the value of (f / g)(1).
If the domain of a function is (-3, 7], and the graph is shifted 4 units right, the new domain is:
questions.explanation: A shift of 4 units to the right means adding 4 to the x-values: (-3 + 4, 7 + 4] = (1, 11].

questions.questionText: Which relation is NOT a function?
questions.explanation: The relation x = |y| fails the vertical line test (e.g., x=4 corresponds to y=4 and y=-4).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5x + 1 and g(x) = 2x, find the expression for (f - g)(x).
The graph of y = f(x) is reflected across the x-axis, then shifted 3 units up. The new equation is:
questions.explanation:
Reflection over x-axis: y = -f(x). 
Shift 3 units up: y = -f(x) + 3.

questions.questionText: What is the domain of f(x) = √x / (x - 4)?
questions.explanation:
Conditions: x ≥ 0 (from √x) AND x ≠ 4 (from the denominator). 
The intersection is [0, 4) ∪ (4, ∞).

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5x and g(x) = 3, find the expression for (f / g)(x) and its domain.
questions.explanation:
(f / g)(x) = 5x / 3.
 Since the denominator is never zero, the domain is R.

questions.questionText: A function that is even is symmetric with respect to the:
questions.explanation: An even function (f(-x) = f(x)) has a graph that is symmetric with respect to the y-axis.

questions.questionText: Which set of ordered pairs represents a function?
questions.explanation: The set {(2, 4), (3, 6), (4, 8)} has unique y-values for each x-value, satisfying the function condition.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 5x + 3 and g(x) = 2, find the value of (f + g)(-1).
Which of the following functions is neither even nor odd?
questions.explanation:
f(-x) = -x³ - 1.
 This is not f(x) and not -f(x).
 The function is neither even nor odd.

questions.questionText: The graph of y = |x - 4| + 1 is the graph of y = |x| shifted:
questions.explanation:
The (x - 4) shifts 4 units right.
 The + 1 shifts 1 unit up.

questions.questionText: If f(x) = 4x - 5 and the codomain is R, the function is:
questions.explanation:
The range of the linear function f(x) = 4x - 5 is R. 
Since the range equals the codomain R, the function is onto.

questions.questionText: What is the range of the function f(x) = 5x - 3 for the domain [-1, 2]?
If f(x) = 2x + 1 and g(x) = 5x, find the value of (f - g)(0).
Which of the following functions is a quadratic function?
questions.explanation:
A quadratic function is a polynomial of degree 2, 
f(x) = ax² + bx + c.
